canonical_evidence.claim: The controlled current-source evidence supports an approximately 45 ms per-launch shared-runner contribution to the xdotool compatibility path while leaving the historical 146.33 ms and clean 32.78 ms results as separate dated measurements.

dependencies.role: clean isolated-runner replication with tracked samples

historical_magnitude.criterion: pooled shared-asyncio xdotool move_click daemon mean must be within 25% of 146.33 ms

launch_scaling.criterion: the 2-launch and 8-launch per-launch deltas should be approximately equal

gates.metric_scope: daemon timing; wall timing is retained as transport context

runner_direction.criterion: shared asyncio must slow xdotool in every one of 3 blocks for move_click and move_click_sequence

validity.criterion: 30/30 successful measurements per retained case in every cell plus successful cursor and type verification

xtest_negative_control.criterion: shared versus isolated move_click must be within 1 ms absolute or 25% relative in every block

historical_context.interpretation: supports a subprocess-runner contribution under controlled modern conditions; does not apportion the full difference from the historical dirty-worktree run
historical_context.purpose: controlled mechanism diagnostic for input backend and subprocess runner interaction

provenance.canonical_cell_digest_scope: canonical compact cell JSON excluding canonical_cell_sha256
provenance.raw_digest_scope: original full SDK JSON before compact secret-safe projection
